Privacy Terms Accessibility Back to Products EL CAMBO OVERDRIVE Classic Tube Overdrive Pedal with Intuitive 3-Knob Interface for Essential Blues Rock Tones 1 / 4 Zoom View in fullscreen EL CAMBO OVERDRIVE Classic Tube Overdrive Pedal with Intuitive 3-Knob Interface for Essential Blues Rock Tones Share Overview Learning Features Downloads About this product Classic Tube Overdrive Pedal with Intuitive 3-Knob Interface for Essential Blues Rock Tones EL CAMBO OVERDRIVE As far as versatile and ubiquitous effects go, an overdrive emulating a pushed tube amp is as good as it gets. EL CAMBO fattens up your tone with a little (or a lot) of extra girth around the waist, providing that highly sought-after midrange “oomph” that cuts through the mix, especially when your band is pushing hard decibels. This particular gritty honk gives your guitar a powerful voice that is ideal for a singing blues solo, and it’s also perfect for a hard rockin’ lead boost over the top of your amp’s already overdriven sound. Crank it up and testify! • Vintage all-analog overdrive • True Bypass • Built like a tank A Mountain of Mids EL CAMBO OVERDRIVE delivers a distinct midrange boost, one that can instantly warm up your tone, even if it’s a bit too jangly to cut through a loud rhythm section. Thanks to its symmetrical clipping overdrive circuit, the harmonic saturation is amazingly fluid and musical sounding. Boost into Epic Solo-Mode With plenty of gain and boost on tap, EL CAMBO can be tailored to work in almost any setting. From adding just a bit of push to your preamp with subtle warmth to your tone, to a screaming overdrive with singing sustain and thickness, EL CAMBO gets you there. Whether the moment calls for blistering Texas-style blues, soulful pop ballads or classic rock riffs – EL CAMBO fits the bill! Roadworthy Made from a sturdy metal housing, this all-analog overdrive will last for years and years without losing that warm tube saturation tone. EL CAMBO’s top-mounted jacks help save pedal board space and corral your cables, while the true bypass operation keeps your signal nice and clean.
